english.title: Cause or permit further dressing procedure on animal before bleeding ends in premises other than slaughterhouse
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), at premises, other than a slaughterhouse, used for the killing of animals, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), caused or permitted further

(A)_[dressing procedure]_
(B)_[electrical stimulation]_

to be performed on a

(C)_[turkey]_
(D)_[goose]_
(E)_[bird, namely **(..SPECIFY BIRD..)]_
(F)_[bovine animal]_
(G)_[sheep]_
(H)_[goat]_
(I)_[pig]_
(J)_[deer]_

which had been bled after simple stunning before the bleeding had ended and, in any event, not before the expiry of a period of not less than

(K)_[2 minutes]_
(L)_[90 seconds]_
(M)_[30 seconds]_
(N)_[20 seconds]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(d) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 42(3) of Schedule 2 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
